(contains the required token). Saved; the saved detail view shows name "fwec21-dg-n1 Bench Opportunity", Account "Bench Account" (href #Account/view/6ae0e3d4d7042e361), description "Created via operator task fwec21-dg-n1.", Amount $1,000.00, Close Date Dec 31, 2025, and navigating back to the Opportunities list shows the pager has grown from "1–3 / 3" to "1–4 / 4". Note: the form silently cleared Amount/Close Date on intermediate re-renders and the first Save click did not submit; fields were re-entered via keystrokes and committed with Tab before the successful save. I did not read back the new row's own name/account cells in the list grid, so the list placement is confirmed only by the total count changing from 3 to 4.
